simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_impulse_sat_app_starts.py, run_dump_impulse_sat_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1") runs from flash using CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF before relocating to DDR, prints "CH455 panel init OK!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA141A7DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE", 2.98 MB) and maincode(AV) ("20020A002340", 12.37 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores ("MC: APP  init ok", main EBase 0x80002000, SEE running at 0xA6000200 with EBase 0x86002001).  The application prints "---led 455 attach OK--" and updates the CH455 panel to " on ", initialises hs_config_init and userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and without the board's anti-clone security IC displays "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to offical SW!-----00000000000000 20020a00" on GMA layer 0 (1280x720).

desc: Amiko Impulse SAT (System ID 20020A00) firmware v2.3.40 (2016-01-15) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3510B / M3503 rev B SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0xA6000200, and an external CH455 4-digit LED / IR sensor eye on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA).
